family: GTK2 public preview: scrollbar arrow/trough junction

reference.comparison: 1:1 pixels, same 15x15 arrow regions as R14/R15

scope: Private GTK2 snapshots and assistant-owned Xephyr :82/:83 only. No product theme, user palette, MAME guest, or other Xephyr was changed.

correction_to_R15.finding: The generated R14 GTK2 arrow assets were already 11x12 vertical and 12x11 horizontal; they were not 11x11 bitmaps. GTK2 recipe geometry explicitly includes the one-pixel axial allowance. Therefore R15's claim that a centered 11x11 overlay left this pixel unpainted was based on an incorrect description of the generated source asset.
correction_to_R15.preserve_history: R15 remains unchanged as historical record; this revision supersedes its proposed asset-overlay cause and test plan.

isolated_geometry_probe.change: Private snapshot only: GtkRange stepper-size 12 to 13; directional overlay canvas 13px, preserving the 11x11 glyph and deriving bevel colors from semantic DomainOS/KDE roles.
isolated_geometry_probe.result: Public crop equality against the SR10.4 15x15 ROIs: up 181/225, down 180/225, left 171/225, right 162/225. Vertical axial outer edge pixels match, but horizontal junction differences remain; alignment and glyph differences are also present.
isolated_geometry_probe.runtime_geometry: Observed minimum-width event changed 49 to 51, confirming the size-13 RC applied.
isolated_geometry_probe.decision: Reject as a product fix. The changed geometry did not establish a consistent four-direction match and does not isolate the GTK2 drawing-order cause.

public_interaction_diagnostic.result: The public arrow press harness returned zero held-state pixel delta in multiple runs, including the unmodified baseline. On Xephyr :82 the first failure was horizontal-left; on :83 it was horizontal-right. XQueryPointer confirmed the pointer was inside the GTK2 toplevel, so the varying failure is not evidence of a missed top-level target.
public_interaction_diagnostic.interpretation: The harness/input outcome is intermittent relative to R14, which passed all four arrows. Do not attribute this to the size-13 candidate or use these failed runs as a behavioral regression conclusion.
public_interaction_diagnostic.next_diagnostic: Inspect delivered GTK/GDK button and range state for the held interval, then repeat once with an event/state receipt that proves the press reached the target before comparing pixels.

cleanup.reason: The generated size-14 overlay was rejected, and the second identical run was redundant. The first candidate run remains for evidence. Xephyr :83 and its Xauthority remain in place.

next: Retain GTK2 as the active family. First make the public input receipt deterministic by proving GDK button delivery and range state during the hold; then compare R14's passing native interaction again only if that receipt identifies a meaningful changed input condition. For visual work, trace parent trough/stepper draw and clipping with the corrected 11x12/12x11 asset dimensions; do not increase stepper-size or replace assets without a four-direction discriminating result.
